stories.title: Son dakika... Emekli Amiral Türker Ertürk hakkında hapis cezası ve tahliye kararı

en.title: Prison sentence and release decision for retired Admiral Türker Ertürk
en.summary: Retired Admiral Türker Ertürk, arrested based on statements made during a television program three years ago, was sentenced to 1 year, 14 months, and 20 days imprisonment and ordered released.

stories.title: Emekli Amiral Türker Ertürk hakkında hapis cezası ve tahliye kararı

en.title: Prison sentence and release decision for retired Admiral Türker Ertürk
en.summary: Retired Admiral Türker Ertürk, arrested based on statements made during a television program three years ago, faced a court decision regarding his case.

stories.title: Vali Davut Gül, İstanbul'un 9 aylık güvenlik verilerini açıkladı: '130 organize suç örgütü çökertildi'

en.title: Governor Davut Gül releases Istanbul's 9-month security data: '130 organized crime groups dismantled'
en.summary: Istanbul's governor reported that 130 organized crime groups were dismantled in the first nine months of 2026, terror operations increased by 20 percent, and shooting incidents decreased by 48 percent.

stories.title: Enflasyon 57 ay sonra yüzde 30’un altına indi: Bakan Şimşek’ten 'düşüş' açıklaması

en.title: Inflation falls below 30 percent for the first time in 57 months: Minister Şimşek's 'decline' statement
en.summary: Turkey's finance minister announced that annual inflation dropped below 30 percent for the first time in 57 months, with declines noted in food, education, and rental inflation.

stories.title: İstanbul'da 2026'nın ilk 9 aylık suç ve operasyon bilançosu açıklandı: 130 çete çökertildi

en.title: Istanbul's first 9 months of 2026 crime and operation report announced: 130 gangs dismantled
en.summary: Istanbul's governor shared security data for the first nine months of 2026, reporting that 343 operations were conducted against organized crime groups and that crimes against property declined significantly.

stories.title: Mansur Yavaş'tan yeni 'Vahap Seçer' açıklaması: Melih Gökçek'i hatırlattı!

en.title: New statement from Mansur Yavaş on 'Vahap Seçer': Recalled Melih Gökçek
en.summary: Ankara's mayor visited the wife of Mersin's mayor and stated that he supports proper legal procedures, referencing the approach taken in a previous case.

stories.title: Soma'da 5 işçinin öldüğü maden faciasında şüpheliler adliyeye sevk edildi

en.title: Suspects transferred to courthouse in mine disaster in Soma where 5 workers died
en.summary: Nine suspects, including the general manager and executives of the mining operation, were transferred to the courthouse following a mine collapse in Soma that killed five workers.

stories.title: Eyüpsultan Belediye Başkanı Mithat Bülent Özmen dahil 28 şüpheli adliyeye sevk edildi

en.title: 28 suspects including Eyüpsultan Municipal Mayor Mithat Bülent Özmen transferred to courthouse
en.summary: Twenty-eight suspects, including the mayor of Eyüpsultan municipality, were transferred to the courthouse as part of an investigation by the Ankara chief prosecutor's office.

stories.title: 57 ay sonra ilk! Bakan Şimşek'ten enflasyon açıklaması: Eşel mobilden kademeli olarak çıkıyoruz

en.title: First in 57 months! Minister Şimşek's inflation statement: We are gradually exiting high inflation
en.summary: Turkey's Treasury and Finance Minister Mehmet Şimşek commented on September inflation data released by the Turkish Statistics Institute, noting that annual inflation has fallen to levels not seen since November 2021.

stories.title: Mansur Yavaş'tan Vahap Seçer tepkisi: Gözaltı hukuka aykırı

en.title: Mansur Yavaş criticizes Vahap Seçer: Detention is unlawful
en.summary: Ankara's mayor Mansur Yavaş expressed opposition to the detention of Mersin's mayor Vahap Seçer, characterizing the detention as contrary to law.

stories.title: Son dakika: Gözaltındaki hakemler adliyeye sevk edildi! Yasin Kol'un milyonluk hesap hareketleri...

en.title: Breaking: Detained judges referred to courthouse! Judge Yasin Kol's account transfers worth millions...
en.summary: Judges Yasin Kol and Göktuğ Hazar Erel were referred to court after detention. Financial authorities prepared a report regarding significant bank transfers from Judge Kol's accounts during a specific period.

stories.title: Mersin'de 3 belediyeye yönelik yolsuzluk soruşturmasında şüpheliler adliyeye sevk edildi

en.title: In Mersin corruption investigation targeting 3 municipalities, suspects referred to court
en.summary: Fifty-nine suspects, including three municipal mayors, were referred to court in connection with a corruption investigation involving Mersin's metropolitan municipality and two district municipalities.

stories.title: Sigortada yeni dönem: Hasar dosyası ve kusur oranı e-Devlet'ten görülebilecek

en.title: New era in insurance: Damage file and fault rate viewable from e-Government
en.summary: Turkey's insurance regulator expanded the e-Government insurance portal to allow citizens faster and easier access to their insurance information, including damage files and fault rates.

stories.title: Nobel Tıp Ödülü'nün sahipleri belli oldu: Beyin araştırmalarını değiştiren keşif

en.title: Nobel Medicine Prize winners announced: Discovery that transformed brain research
en.summary: Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann, and Georg Nagel won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for developing optogenetics, a technique enabling light-based control of nerve cells. They will share a prize worth 12 million Swedish kronor.

stories.title: Fed faiz kararı ne zaman, hangi tarihte açıklanacak? Fed faiz yükseltecek mi?

en.title: When will Fed interest rate decision be announced? Will the Fed raise rates?
en.summary: As October progresses, anticipation builds regarding the Federal Reserve's next interest rate decision following recent economic data on inflation and employment.

stories.title: Futbolda para ligi değişti: Real Madrid zirvede, Arsenal peşinde

en.title: Football's money league changed: Real Madrid on top, Arsenal in pursuit
en.summary: The world's 50 most valuable football club brands reached a combined value of 27.6 billion dollars, with Real Madrid leading while Arsenal climbed into the top three for the first time.

stories.title: Vali Davut Gül, İstanbul'un 9 aylık güvenlik verilerini açıkladı: 130 çete çökertildi, 2 bin 517 kişi tutuklandı

en.title: Governor Davut Gül Releases Istanbul's 9-Month Security Data: 130 Gangs Dismantled, 2,517 People Arrested
en.summary: Istanbul's governor reported security statistics for the first nine months of 2026, noting a 20 percent increase in operations against terrorist organizations compared to the same period last year. Operations against organized crime groups resulted in 130 gangs being dismantled and 2,517 arrests.
